name: Georgia GHSA State Cross Country Championships
headline: Georgia GHSA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Carrollton won the 7A boys title with 62 points over Harrison (142), led by individual champion Drew Woznicki (15:54.47), and Marietta edged Harrison 48-53 for the 7A girls title as North Gwinnett’s Cadee Benz won in 18:34.44. Bowdon’s Averi Lowen won the 1A girls race in 17:49.83.
